name: Diamond-class cruiser
description: The Diamond-class cruiser, also known simply as the Commerce Guild cruiser and Commerce Guild Starship, was a class of cruiser used by the Commerce Guild. Forty-one such ships were involved in the First Battle of Geonosis, which was the first battle of the Clone Wars.

data.name: Diamond-class cruiser
data.complement: OG-9 homing spider droids or DSD1 dwarf spider droids
